assessments.source_anchor: Use this skill when building Android apps with custom real-time video sessions.

Its Android lifecycle, architecture, join pattern, scenarios, reference map, troubleshooting, and runbook support the requested branded waiting room, consultation controls, connection handling, and physical-device testing without a prebuilt meeting screen.
